name: Epistaxis
hyTerms: Never cauterise both septal sides simultaneously

reference.source: Dhingra Diseases of ENT 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Pinch soft nose leaning forward 15 minutes first
Never cauterise both septal sides simultaneously
Posterior packs admit: hypoxia and toxic shock risks
SPA ligation controls refractory posterior bleeds
reference.pathophysiology: Superficial septal plexus vessels rupture with mucosal drying and trauma, while posterior arterial branches bleed under higher pressure into the pharynx; coagulopathy and hypertension aggravate but rarely initiate bleeding.
additionalDifferentials: Anterior versus posterior bleed by flow direction and age
HHT telangiectasia versus local vessel bleed
Juvenile angiofibroma in adolescent male recurrent bleeds
additionalInvestigations: Full blood count, coagulation and group and hold when severe
CT angiography or angiography for refractory cases
